name: p2-round5-trend-dip
budget_note: user-specified strategy hypothesis (2026-09-17): above the 30w/60w line, below the 5d/10d line; 4 configs of the round-5 budget; preregistered BEFORE the expanded window diagnostic is viewed, so no diagnostic result feeds this design

data.price_convention: moving averages on the adjusted close; weekly lines expressed in trading sessions (30w = 150, 60w = 300; A-share week = 5 sessions, approximation disclosed)

R5-trend-dip-30w-5d.hypothesis: 处于150日均线上方（长期趋势向上）且跌破5日均线（短期回调）的股票，次开进场持有5日，费用后优于同池基准
R5-trend-dip-30w-5d.rank: deepest pullback below the short line first (score = sma5/adj_close - 1)

R5-trend-dip-60w-5d.hypothesis: 同上，长期线用300日均线（60周）

execution.entry: next session open after signal close

fees.disclosure: stamp segments institutional facts; commission segments conservative assumptions (user actual 万1 all-in is P3 scope)

validation.isolation: dev events must exit on or before 2020-12-31; validation events have signal_date >= 2021-01-01
validation.history_note: 2015-2024 inspected by the old project: rolling historical validation, never unseen-sample proof

dev_pass: mean net per completed event beats pool_equal_weight mean on dev
per-year net edge vs pool positive in >= 4 of 6 dev years
top-decile symbol share of total net profit <= 40%
validation_pass: mean net per completed event beats pool_equal_weight mean on validation
per-year net edge vs pool positive in >= 2 of 4 validation years
selection_rule.multiple_testing: 4 preregistered configs (cumulative: 23 configs + 20-factor survey + window diagnostic + this); survivors at most 2 proceed to P3; any post-hoc re-picking downgrades to exploratory

benchmarks.broad_index_note: deferred until real index data is fetched
benchmarks.random_pick: 3 random eligible picks/day through identical pipeline, seed 17
